newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER KONRAD IS UNDER FIRE AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GOALKEEPER KONRAD IS UNDER FIRE AGAIN.

text.p: Austrian Otto Konrad is finding goalkeeping a hazardous occupation.
Hit by a bottle thrown from the crowd in Italy two seasons ago, he has now been struck by a firework at a Spanish match.
Playing for Zaragoza, Konrad was felled by the firework thrown from the stands in Sunday's Spanish league game at Athletic Bilbao.
Konrad was taken to hospital with first degree burns near the eye but had fully recovered by Monday and was expected to resume training later in the week.
Spanish soccer authorities are to investigate the incident which could cost Athletic a stadium closure similar to that handed out to AC Milan when Konrad was previously attacked.

UEFA docked the Italian team two European Cup Champions' League points and closed their San Siro stadium for two games because of the injury to Konrad during Casino Salzburg's game there in September 1994.
